meta.title: Innologic | Business software that follows your whole day
meta.description: Innologic builds business software: ERP for trading, retail and distribution, a point of sale for shops and for restaurants and cafés, and software for property developers and property managers. Set up and supported by the people who build it.

hero.kicker: Business software, set up for you
hero.text: Innologic builds software for companies that sell, serve and build: ERP for trading and distribution, a point of sale for shops and for restaurants, and software for property developers and managers. Everything stays connected, so you stop retyping and start trusting your numbers.
hero.fine: The first conversation is free, and we will tell you honestly if it is not the right fit.

fnb.heading: A point of sale built for restaurants and cafés
fnb.text: Tables, kitchen, bill and stock work as one. The waiter takes the order, the kitchen gets its ticket, the guest pays, and your ingredients and books update by themselves.
fnb.mockNote: A demo restaurant. All screens show sample data.
fnb.flowHeading: From the table to the books
fnb.flowSub: One order, five steps, nothing typed twice.
fnb.featuresSub: Everything the floor needs, with the back office behind it.
fnb.note: Not included today: ordering from your own website or app, and automatic import of delivery-app orders (GoFood, GrabFood, ShopeeFood), which the cashier enters by hand. If you need them, tell us. Receipts, service charge and VAT should be checked with your tax advisor.

flow.title: Open the table
flow.text: Pick it on the floor plan and add dishes with notes, on a PC or a tablet.

flow.title: Send to the kitchen
flow.text: The kitchen and the bar each get their own ticket or screen.

flow.title: Serve and bill
flow.text: Move or merge tables, split the bill and apply a promotion.

flow.title: Take payment
flow.text: Cash, QRIS, card or transfer, even several on one bill.

flow.title: Stock and books follow
flow.text: Ingredients leave stock by recipe and the sale lands in the day's report and the books.

cards.title: Tables and floor plan
cards.text: Draw your floors and tables. Open bills show on the plan. Move a party to another table, merge two bills or split one.

cards.title: Kitchen and bar
cards.text: A kitchen screen shows what to cook, and tickets print per station. Mark dishes ready and served as they go out.

cards.title: Menu with recipes
cards.text: Groups, categories and dishes with photos. Each dish has a recipe, so every sale takes the ingredients out of stock and shows the food cost.

cards.title: Payments and shifts
cards.text: Several payment methods on one bill, opening and closing of shifts, a cash drawer, and refunds approved by the manager.

cards.title: Service charge and VAT
cards.text: Service charge, packing or delivery fees by type of bill (dine-in, takeaway, delivery), with VAT worked out on top. You set the percentages.

cards.title: Promotions and packages
cards.text: Percentage promotions by day, hour, payment method or menu. Bundles such as "coffee plus two lattes", and prepaid vouchers such as five coffees to take later.

cards.title: Customer display
cards.text: A second screen facing the guest shows the bill as it grows, the promotions of the moment, the QRIS code and a thank-you.

cards.title: Tablets and touch screens
cards.text: Touch mode with big buttons and an on-screen number pad, full screen, and an installable app icon when your site runs over HTTPS.

cards.title: Cost control
cards.text: Food cost % for every dish against your target, alerts when ingredients get dearer, and records for waste, staff meals and stock count differences.

more.title: Guests order from the table
more.text: Every table has its own QR code. Guests scan it with their phone, see the menu with pictures, send their order, call the waiter or ask for the bill, with no app and no login. Staff accept the order and it goes straight to the kitchen or bar.

more.title: GoFood, GrabFood and ShopeeFood orders
more.text: The cashier types each order from the platform's tablet. The commission is worked out, what the platform owes you is booked as a receivable, and every payout is matched to the orders it paid. Orders are entered by hand, not imported automatically.

more.title: Control at the counter
more.text: A supervisor PIN is needed to void a dish the kitchen already has or to give a big discount. A report shows voids, discounts, reprints and cash differences per cashier, so you know where to look.

more.title: Reports for the owner
more.text: A restaurant dashboard with sales, average bill, sales by weekday and hour, top menu items and payment methods. It also shows your prime cost against a target, which dishes earn money (menu engineering), and a daily sales sheet split into food and beverage.

more.title: Staff roles and devices
more.text: Manager, cashier or waiter, kitchen and bar, and purchasing and stock roles, each with its own access. Every tablet or PC that logs in is registered as a device, and you can block one that is lost.

more.title: The back office is included
more.text: Ingredient purchasing with unit conversions (buy in kg, use in grams), suppliers, stock counts, prepared items such as sauces and doughs, accounting, bank reconciliation, budgets and tax, in the same system.

more.title: Loyalty members
more.text: Guests join as members at the cashier or by scanning a QR code, and earn points on every paid bill. Set your own tiers (for example Silver and Gold) with bigger rewards, let guests pay part of the bill with points, give a birthday dish, and set how long a membership lasts. Reports show your top members and points earned, used and expired.

items.q: Do you have a point of sale for restaurants and cafés?
items.a: Yes. The restaurant POS has a table floor plan, orders with notes, a kitchen screen and station tickets, split and merged bills, several payment methods, shifts and a cash drawer. Each dish has a recipe, so ingredients leave stock when you sell. Accounting, purchasing and tax are in the same system.

items.q: Can guests order from their phone at the table?
items.a: Yes. Every table has a QR code. Guests scan it, choose from the menu and send the order, and your staff accept it before it goes to the kitchen or bar. No app or login is needed. On your restaurant Wi-Fi it works on your own network. For guests on mobile data, the system needs an internet address (HTTPS), which we help you set up.

items.q: Does it connect to GoFood, GrabFood and ShopeeFood?
items.a: Not automatically yet. The cashier types the order from the platform's tablet. The system then books the sale, works out the commission, records what the platform owes you, and matches each payout to its orders. Automatic import is not available today.

items.q: Which printers and devices does the restaurant POS work with?
items.a: It runs in a browser on a PC, laptop or tablet. Kitchen, bar and receipt tickets can print on 58 mm or 80 mm thermal printers over your network (for example Epson TM-T82 or TM-T88, Xprinter, Sunmi), on a USB printer shared from the server PC, or through the normal browser print dialog. We test your printers during setup, and the receipt printer can open the cash drawer.

items.q: Can it add service charge and VAT to the bill?
items.a: Yes. You can set service charge, packing or delivery fees by type of bill, and the VAT percentage (11% by default). Paid bills keep the percentages they were paid with. Please confirm the right rates with your tax advisor.

items.q: Do we need cloud hosting or constant internet?
items.a: No. Innologic runs on a computer or small server in your office, and your staff use it in their browser over your network. Secure remote access can be arranged if you need it.

items.q: Can it handle several branches or companies?
items.a: Yes. Branches and departments can be tracked separately, and each company keeps its own books, with billing between companies and group statements.

items.q: Can we bring our existing products and customers?
items.a: Yes. We help import products, customers, vendors and opening balances so you do not start from zero.

Users only see what their role allows, changes are recorded in an activity log, and two-factor login is available. We set up regular backups and recommend a copy on a second drive or in cloud storage.

items.q: Is the tax output ready to file?
items.a: It records and exports the data you need for VAT, PPh and Coretax e-Faktur. Please confirm rates and filing details with your tax advisor.
It depends on the size of your business and how much setup and training you need. Send us a message for a clear quote.
